definition: אֹבֹת proper name, of a location ( water-skins ) station of Israel in wilderness Num 21:10 ; Num 34:43 not yet determined, probably on eastern skirts of Idumea not far from Moab; accusative to Wetzst in De Ct 168 Wêba , in the Arabah, but identification not probably; compare Di on Num 21:10 .
